_read_me: Limits for 2-FETCH-ALL.bat. You may change them (lower is kinder to the servers). Values below the floors are ignored: at least 2 s between requests to one host (10 s for apps.fs.usda.gov), and robots.txt Crawl-delay and Retry-After always win when they ask for more. robots_html_200_means_no_rules (true / false; anything else = false): true = a robots.txt address that answers HTTP 200 with a web page holding NO robots line (no User-agent / Allow / Disallow / Sitemap / Crawl-delay line), from the site's own /robots.txt and not a login or captcha page, is read as "no rules" (RFC 9309: only parseable lines are rules); false = such a host is BLOCKED (hand download), as in 3.6.1. 5xx, 429, no answer and redirects to a login are never "no rules".
